notes.title: $0.99 Steam Sale for Domino Effect
notes.content: Domino Effect is only 99 Cents from now until May! Support me as a developer while blowing stuff up at the same time. Thank you ALL!

notes.title: Demo Now Available
notes.content: The Demo for Domino Effect is now available! Now you can learn how to use hardcore, physics defying weaponry at no cost! I will also be reducing the price of the full game to $0.99 very soon. So add it to your wishlist if you like ;)

notes.title: Demo Available 3/13/2018
notes.content: Try it before you buy it! The demo for Domino Effect will be available on 3/13/2018. It actually will pretty much be the full version of the game. If it runs on your computer, and you have fun playing, then add Domino Effect to your wishlist and get it when it's like a buck! The full version will probably unlock features like unlimited singualrity ammo or something. Don't for get to subscribe!

notes.title: User-Friendliness Update
notes.content:
The feedback, so far, dictates that I should focus on "User-Friendliness" for the first update. After all, what good is having super gnarly powers if you don't know how to use them. Therefore, I shall overhaul the GUI in a manner that displays more information about what does what, as well as beautify the visual representation all together. This should only take a day or two. So check back around the 23rd for a more sexy interface ;)

If YOU would like to offer YOUR constructive criticism, then please do so in the "Criticism" forum and I shall respond accordingly.
